prompt: For PMS software, compare per-property and per-room metrics against customer value and seasonal usage. Model small/large properties, seasonal peaks, implementation costs and support before proposing tiers. Give a read-only recommendation; do not touch live systems.
rubric: Compare value metrics for customer comprehension, alignment with benefit, predictability and margin. Choose flat, seat, usage, tier, credit, outcome or hybrid pricing based on those tradeoffs. Separate packaging research from demand estimation: Van Westendorp measures perceived acceptability; MaxDiff informs relative preference. Test candidate prices against actual purchase behavior and retention before rollout.

Show cost and usage scenarios, included limits, overage behavior and gross-margin sensitivity. Define new-customer pilot criteria, notice/migration policy and conversion, net revenue, churn and refund guardrails.

If evidence is incomplete, state exactly which conclusion cannot be supported and what observation would resolve it. Check for instrumentation faults, cohort selection, seasonality and delayed outcomes before attributing a change to an intervention. Keep unrelated workflows unloaded.
Preserve authorization and relevant privacy/security boundaries.
